content.short: Headquarters (HQ.xyz) is the on-chain business account, unifying token payments, fiat ramps, and treasury reporting.
content.description: Headquarters (HQ.xyz) is the on-chain business account designed to unify and streamline operations in today’s on-chain economy. It provides a focused suite of services for corporate crypto finance, including batch token payments, crypto-to-fiat payouts, and treasury reporting. By centralizing these capabilities, Headquarters helps teams manage payments, cash flow, and financial visibility within the Web3 landscape. This cohesive platform is built to support organizations as they perform essential on-chain financial tasks with clarity and efficiency.
